name: blueprint-architect-plugin
description: Turn product requirements into reviewed, compatible project blueprints before coding.

interface.shortDescription: Interpret PRDs and design compatible project blueprints.
interface.longDescription: Blueprint Architect explains the product problem, guides material architecture decisions with structured selectors, checks compatibility, and generates a confirmed project blueprint.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $blueprint-architect to interpret my PRD and guide me through a compatible project blueprint.
